articles.title: Crypto vault deposits top $10 billion as lending risks draw regulatory scrutiny
articles.snippet: Curator-managed lending strategies are attracting institutional capital, while exposing depositors to collateral, liquidity and smart-contract risks.

articles.title: BlackRock Files for 'Buffer' Bitcoin ETF as IBIT Draws $665M in a Day
articles.snippet: The iShares Bitcoin Managed Protection ETF would use options on IBIT to limit losses, in exchange for giving up some upside.
